# Unfold

> Unfold turns units of work (Work Items: decided intent, or a problem described well enough to conceive a solution) into pull requests written by AI agents. Ploeg authorizes, budgets and runs every agent Run; Unfold is its front end. Self-hosted and pre-1.0; a hosted offering for agencies is decided but not built.

Use Ploeg's terms: a Run is one Role executing against a Work Item, a Shift is the whole attempt, and a Lease is the right to write the Shift's branch. Code and executable tests describe the implementation; research and ADR pages are records.
